name: Hing Yip Holdings Limited
summary: China Investments Holdings Limited, an investment holding company and a subsidiary of Prize Rich Inc., maintains a varied business portfolio spanning Hong Kong and Mainland China. Its operations encompass several key areas, including advanced data solutions such as developing industrial internet platforms, building smart city infrastructure, and managing big data. The company is also a manufacturer and supplier of civil explosives, providing products like emulsion explosives and industrial detonating cords. In the real estate domain, it is involved in property development, possesses investment properties and assets intended for sale, and takes part in the construction and development of industrial parks, alongside property trading. Financial services offered by the company include finance lease consulting and financing, in addition to providing general financial investment services. Furthermore, China Investments Holdings operates and owns hotels, delivers wellness and elderly care services, produces and trades medium density fiberboards, offers transportation for both general and hazardous goods, and generates and sells electricity. The company, founded in 1993, is based in Tsimshatsui, Hong Kong.
